components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cloth-covered button with an inset stitch line. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font: 600 0.95rem/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #efe9d6; background-color: oklch(31% 0.09 268); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12) inset, 0 3px 8px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transition: background-color 0.18s, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 1.5px dashed rgb(239 233 214 / 0.62); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn:hover { background-color: oklch(37% 0.1 268); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14) inset, 0 6px 12px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3) inset; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #efe9d6; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px oklch(97.6% 0.007 95); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline companion to the primary button, for the second action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border: 1.5px solid oklch(23% 0.02 265); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: oklch(23% 0.02 265); cursor: pointer; font: 600 0.95rem/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.18s; } .ds-btn-ghost::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 1.5px dashed rgb(31 33 45 / 0.4); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(94.6% 0.01 95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(23% 0.02 265); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Top-bar link with a dashed stitch underline that closes to solid on hover and for the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font: 600 0.92rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(23% 0.02 265); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.3rem 0 0.25rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 55%, transparent 0) 0 100% / 8px 1.5px repeat-x; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-size: 100% 1.5px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(23% 0.02 265); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Claim status. Border style carries the status as well as colour: solid, dashed, double.
components.html: Verified Unverified Discarded
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.12rem 0.45rem; font: 700 0.72rem/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-chip-ok { color: oklch(40% 0.09 190); } .ds-chip-q { color: oklch(47% 0.19 25); border-style: dashed; } .ds-chip-x { color: oklch(43% 0.02 265); border-style: double; border-width: 3px; padding: 0.12rem 0.4rem; }

components.name: Slip
components.description: A tipped-in paper note with a dashed stitched border. Marks a verified, unverified, discarded or caution passage. Never nested.
components.html:
Unverified

Reported in secondary sources; not found in the primary text.
components.css: .ds-slip { margin: 0; padding: 0.95rem 1.15rem 0.35rem; background: oklch(94.6% 0.01 95); border: 1.5px dashed oklch(47% 0.19 25); border-radius: 3px; font: 1rem/1.55 Literata, Georgia, serif; color: oklch(23% 0.02 265); } .ds-slip-head { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font: 700 0.9rem/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(47% 0.19 25); } .ds-slip p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0.6em; }

components.name: Volume
components.description: A collection as a cloth-bound book with a sewn spine. Its height follows the number of papers.
components.html: Sufi practice2 papers
components.css: .ds-vol { position: relative; display: block; width: 216px; height: 336px; border-radius: 4px 8px 8px 4px; color: #efe9d6; text-decoration: none; background-color: oklch(31% 0.09 268); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12) inset, 0 10px 18px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-vol:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); } .ds-vol:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(23% 0.02 265); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-vol-spine { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 40px; background: oklch(23% 0.07 268); border-radius: 4px 0 0 4px; background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 5px 9px at 20px 12px, #efe9d6 60%, transparent 62%); background-size: 40px 24px; } .ds-vol-title { position: absolute; left: 58px; top: 24px; right: 16px; font: 650 1.45rem/1.12 Literata, Georgia, serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-vol-count { position: absolute; left: 58px; bottom: 18px; font: 600 0.8rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A research library read as a book whose binding is left showing. Collections are cloth-bound volumes, papers are signatures sewn into them, and one linen chain-stitch runs down every page as spine, progress and contents at once. The page is quiet rag paper with dark ink; all colour and texture belong to the cloth. The one authored motion is the chain sewing itself shut, and it is off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One chain-stitch spine at the left edge, doubling as progress and navigation.
Flat rag-paper reading surface; depth lives on cloth.
A bookcloth colour per collection, inherited by its papers.
Claims carry a mark that never relies on colour alone.
Dashed stitch lines stand in for borders around anything tipped in.

rules.name: The One Cloth Rule
rules.body: A page shows one cloth. A paper takes its collection's cloth; no page mixes two.

rules.name: The Colour-Is-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status has a second cue: dotted underline for verified, wavy underline with a question mark for unverified, light cross-stitch for discarded; chips repeat it with solid, dashed and double borders.

rules.name: The Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Argument is serif; apparatus (navigation, chips, labels, diagram text, slip headings) is Archivo. Never set a paragraph in the sans.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: A shadow means this is cloth. Never put a drop shadow on anything that is paper.

dos: Do let cloth carry colour and depth, and keep paper flat.
Do pair every status colour with a second cue.
Do use dashed 1.5px lines for anything tipped in, and the 24px pitch for anything stitched.
Do keep one authored motion and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do let wide figures and tables scroll in their own container instead of shrinking text.
Do label demonstration data as synthetic.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or textures to paper.
Don't mix two cloths on one page, or tint paper with the cloth colour.
Don't set body text or paragraphs in the sans.
Don't use colour alone to say a claim is verified, unverified or discarded.
Don't nest slips or wrap content in generic cards.
Don't add wood grain, page curls or other skeuomorphic props; every texture must be thread or weave.
